title: tennessee-lpm Institutional Mandate Record
description: A single named, dated commitment by a real Tennessee education authority. Unlike pennsylvania-lpm's central case (a single school district's own board), every one of Tennessee's three major mandates in this repo's founding story -- the 1925 Butler Act, the 1973 'equal time' law, and the 2012 Teacher Protection Act -- is a STATE-level statute, passed by the Tennessee General Assembly and signed (or allowed to become law) by the Governor. The computable unit for 'what does this authority actually require', so a coherence-finding record can point at exactly which mandate it tests, and a query can ask 'how did the state's own statutory approach change across a century of recurrence'. Modeled on deutsche_lp's/nys_lp's/india-lpm's/florida-lpm's/pennsylvania-lpm's institutional-mandate-record.schema.json; mandateType's 'school-district-policy' value (added for pennsylvania-lpm's Dover case) is inherited unchanged but not expected to be used here.

jurisdiction.description: 'US-TN' for a Tennessee-specific mandate; 'US' for a multi-state or federal-level mandate (e.g. NGSS, a federal court ruling's binding scope).

issuingBody.description: Free text, e.g. 'Tennessee State Board of Education', 'Tennessee Department of Education (TDOE)', 'Tennessee Legislature'. Not a controlled vocabulary.

mandateType.description: 'state-board-adopted-standard' = a formal Tennessee State Board of Education rule-making action adopting a standards document (e.g. the current Tennessee Academic Standards for Science). 'state-statute' = a Tennessee statute passed by the General Assembly and signed (or allowed to become law without signature) by the Governor -- this is the type for all three of this repo's central mandates: the 1925 Butler Act (a criminal prohibition on teaching evolution), the 1973 'equal time' law, and the 2012 Teacher Protection Act. 'state-policy-announcement' = a TDOE/Governor's-office policy direction not yet a formal rule. 'commission-recommendation' = a recommendation from an advisory committee or workgroup, not yet itself binding. 'state-guidance-document' = TDOE implementation guidance released to districts. 'school-district-policy' = a binding curriculum mandate issued by an individual school district's own board, not the state -- inherited from pennsylvania-lpm (the level Dover Area School District's 2004 policy operated at), kept for structural parity though no Tennessee mandate in this repo's founding session needed it.

interdisciplinaryExplicitness.description: Optional, kept for structural parity with deutsche_lp/nys_lp's identical field -- whether this mandate's own text uses interdisciplinary/cross-subject framing. Expected to be 'silent-on-cross-subject' or 'unspecified' for most Tennessee science-standards mandates, which are typically single-subject benchmark lists rather than cross-subject graduation frameworks; not required.

statementText.description: The mandate's own text, quoted exactly (or as exactly as the available source allows) as read in the primary source -- e.g. the literal benchmark text of SC.912.L.15.1, or the literal statutory text of an instructional-materials-objection provision. Do not paraphrase where a verbatim quote is available.

targetDate.description: If the mandate names a completion/implementation horizon distinct from its adoption date (e.g. 'full implementation begins school year 2027-28' for a prospective 2026 readoption).

status.description: 'adopted' = formally in force (a completed State Board regulatory rulemaking, a signed statute, an enacted school-district board policy). 'proposed' = drafted/released for public comment or introduced but not yet binding. 'superseded' = replaced by a later mandate (link via supersededBy).

accessTier.description: How much of the underlying mandate document this record actually keeps, chosen per-source based on what's legally safe to redistribute for this document -- not one all-or-nothing repo-wide rule. Governs statementText specifically. 'full-text-stored' = statementText reproduces the mandate's full relevant text -- the de facto tier this repo uses for Tennessee's own statute/standards text, a public record. 'excerpt-only' = statementText is a short, bounded quotation. 'summary-only' = statementText is paraphrase only. 'citation-only' = no statementText at all. Identical field to deutsche_lp's/nys_lp's/india-lpm's/florida-lpm's/pennsylvania-lpm's institutional-mandate-record.schema.json.

licenseOrRightsNote.description: The legal basis for storing this mandate's statementText at the accessTier chosen above, e.g. 'Tennessee state-government publications, enacted statute text, and State Board of Education rule text are public records' for a state-level mandate, or 'a state appellate court's own published opinion (e.g. the Tennessee Supreme Court's 1927 Scopes ruling) is a public judicial record' for a court record. Mirrors OpenLPM's standards_documents.license_or_rights_note field (openlpm migration 019) for ecosystem-wide naming consistency.
